base.description: Spec default. T_tc, T_in, T_final_readme from the README task sections; Round 1 profile from optimized_ncu_metrics.json; DRAM field dram__throughput.

dram_gpu_field.description: As base with DRAM field gpu__dram_throughput.

t_in_prompt_round2.description: As base with T_in from Round 2 opt_prompt.txt: the start time of the Round 1 worker that ended at T_R1. The Round 1 prompt carries no such time.

t_in_prompt_round2_median.description: As base with T_in the median of the four worker start times in the Round 2 opt_prompt.txt history.

readme_example_output.description: As base with T_tc, T_in, T_final_readme from the README example benchmark output. That block prints only two tasks; the others are null.

profile_start_input_kernel.description: As base with the profile start taken from Round 1 input_ncu_metrics.json, the input kernel, not the Round 1 output.

readme_round_table.description: As base with T_R1, T_best, r_best from the README running-best table (bold cell), so no per-round record enters the times.

profile_scope_note: Spec requires profiles only for matrix-vector, MaxPool 3D, 3D transposed conv; all five are written.
